name: Nocturne Durability Mod
author: Nocturne
description: Standalone Koudelka weapon durability HUD (100% Co-op Safe): displays live current/max durability whenever you highlight a weapon in the Equip, Items, or Battle Weapon menus, plus optional equipped-weapon durability bars and low-durability warnings.

settings.label: Menu Weapon Durability
settings.description: Show live durability for whichever weapon is highlighted in Equip, Items, or Battle Weapon menus

settings.label: Equipped Durability HUD
settings.description: Show equipped weapon durability bars for Koudelka, Edward & James during exploration and battle

settings.label: Low Durability Warning %
settings.description: Trigger a Gothic warning toast when an equipped weapon drops below this %

settings.label: Toggle Hotkey
settings.description: In-game key to show/hide Nocturne Durability Mod overlays
